name: The Cook
sample_note: Two spoken lines only (ch011-d0059, ch011-d0062). In the kitchen (ch006) she says nothing; she only joins the lullaby chorus 'Wow! wow! wow!' (ch006-d0030, d0032, speaker label CHORUS, shared with the baby, type verse — not in the back-test denominator). Rules beyond her two lines are tagged inferred:true.

register.level: blunt, surly kitchen servant; monosyllabic, unimpressed by rank
register.summary: She speaks with objects, not words: saucepans, plates and a frying-pan in the kitchen (ch006-p29, p43), a pepper-box in court (ch011-p64). When forced to answer the King she gives the fewest words possible — a flat refusal (Shan't) and a two-word answer (Pepper, mostly) — with no title, no please, no explanation. Per SUP-002 a human performer in plain kitchen dress, textually human.

catchphrases.note: pepper is her motif in both chapters (ch006-p20-p21 the peppered soup; ch011-p64 the pepper-box)

sentence_style.length: one or two words (mean 1.5); never a full sentence. Any new line should stay at 1-4 words

patterns.rule: Refusal as a bare contraction, no reason and no title (Shan't).
Answers the literal question in a clipped noun phrase plus one qualifier (Pepper, mostly).

In the kitchen she is wordless: her temper is thrown, not spoken; her only 'voice' is the gruff 'Wow! wow! wow!' chorus with the baby. If the screenplay needs a kitchen line it is a one-word bark about the soup or the pepper.
patterns.reason: ch006 gives her no dialogue (ch006-p19-p21, p29, p34, p43); the bark rule extends her two trial lines to the kitchen.

examples.text: Wow! wow! wow! (chorus, sung with the baby)
(narrative) The cook threw a frying-pan after her as she went out

preferred_fields: the kitchen: soup, pepper, the pot

address.to_the_king: no title at all — 'Shan't' to a direct royal order is her whole characterisation
address.to_alice: never addresses her; does not even seem to listen (ch006-p34)

forbidden_words.reason: she refuses the King without a title (ch011-d0059) and ignores the Duchess and Alice; courtesy is out of character
12 or more words breaks her monosyllabic register (source max = 2 words)

drift.change: Kitchen: speechless and violent — stirring, peppering, throwing pans; only the 'Wow!' chorus.
Witness box: still minimal, but now verbal defiance — a flat refusal to the King, then a two-word answer — before she vanishes in the Dormouse confusion (ch011-p72).

backtest.method: marker-claim back-test (shared yardstick with pb1 and 01-story/dialogue-rewrite): a spoken source line hits when it matches >=1 backtest_markers regex and no forbidden_words regex; verse excluded; full definition runs/p3-dialogue-style-pb2/result.json#backtest_method
backtest.small_sample_warning: only 2 spoken source line(s); the hit rate is not statistically meaningful - rules tagged inferred:true carry the card beyond the source
